name: echo-intel-calle
description: EchoIntel — a conversation intelligence studio for voice interactions with a live call view, waveform, streaming transcript and a local analysis pipeline behind a typed Call-E integration boundary

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "import {cpSync} from 'fs'; import {resolve} from 'path'; cpSync(resolve('public'), resolve('dist/public'), {recursive: true}); console.log('Copied public to dist/public')"
